venue: NeurIPS 2025 ML×OR workshop · journal version in preparation
title: Policies for Multistage Decisions
summary: A policy may prescribe a reachable state transition from observed history while an optimization over the operational model computes the controls that realize it. Two-stage generalized decision rules provide a specific policy class and train it with target-constraint multipliers.
thumb_alt: Training a state-consistent decision rule: a recurrent policy emits targets stage by stage, and the duals of independent stage problems train it.

title: Learning Solution Maps
summary: Optimization proxies amortize repeated solves across related problem instances. The subject compares direct prediction, repair and completion constructions, learned correction of a tractable model, and first-order supervision of solver-selected local response.
thumb_alt: Masked Sobolev training: a proxy matches solver decisions and a sparse mask of their sensitivities.

title: Differentiating Optimization Models
summary: An outer criterion may depend on the solution of an embedded decision problem with a different objective. DiffOpt.jl computes the value and solution sensitivities of smooth, possibly nonconvex JuMP models with respect to their named parameters.
thumb_alt: Dispatch, price and generation sensitivities as functions of demand.

title: Continuation-Value Representations
summary: Cutting planes bound a future cost only if it is convex. Input-convex networks trained on single-period optimal-power-flow costs, including nonconvex AC costs, matched unrestricted networks in average accuracy on grids up to 6,468 buses; their cuts are supports of the network and carry no bound on the AC cost.
thumb_alt: A convex cost curve with supporting cuts next to an unrestricted fit.

title: Learned Model Correction
summary: DC optimal power flow, the linear program used in dispatch and market clearing, remains the procedure that computes the dispatch, while a network predicts per-demand line susceptances and shunt conductances that bring its solution close to AC-OPF, trained through the linear program’s solution sensitivities.
thumb_alt: DC2AC training pipeline: demand, neural network, adjusted DC-OPF, regression against AC solutions.

title: Endogenous Response
summary: When an agent’s outcome is determined by another agent’s optimization, as when a market operator clears producers’ offers, the decision problem is a Stackelberg game with that optimization as follower. Sensitivity-based and derivative-free search through AC clearing are compared, including when each fails.
thumb_alt: Producer profit as a function of offered volume under DC market clearing.

title: Uncertainty and Ambiguity
summary: A decision optimized against an estimated conditional law inherits its estimation error, shift, and misspecification. This subject studies ambiguity-set calibration and the point at which a statistical description must be replaced by an endogenous response model.
thumb_alt: A budget uncertainty set for two assets next to uncertain efficient frontiers.

title: Planning and Realization Mismatch
summary: Hydrothermal planning values water with SDDP on convex or linear network models while the grid obeys AC power flow. Planning with five network models and operating each policy on AC shows that relaxation tightness did not order the resulting policies.
thumb_alt: Planned versus implemented cost for four network models.
role: Decisions under uncertainty and model mismatch
